import numpy as np, cv2, time, json, argparse
from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion, distance_transform_edt
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
OUT='/app/output'

def metrics(ink):
 t=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<128;m=ink>=.5
 inter=(m&t).sum(); union=(m|t).sum();dt=distance_transform_edt(~t)
 b=m^binary_erosion(m);bt=t^binary_erosion(t)
 prec=(distance_transform_edt(~bt)[b]<=1/.22186).mean();rec=(distance_transform_edt(~b)[bt]<=1/.22186).mean()
 return {'iou':inter/union,'precision':inter/max(1,m.sum()),'recall':inter/t.sum(),'stray':(m&(dt>1/.22186)).sum()/t.sum(),'bf':2*prec*rec/(prec+rec)}

def run(width=.8, spacing=.3, neutral=.24, speed=.025, prime_speed=.18, score=True):
 s=Session('/app/instance.json');s.reset();s.record_start(); p=s.primitives(); quat=s.tip_down_quat();t0=time.time()
 def ik(pos):
  r=s.kinematics({'op':'ik','targets':{'tip':list(pos)+list(quat)},'seed':list(s.hold_action()),'tol_pos_m':1e-5})
  if not r['ok']:raise RuntimeError(r)
  return r['q']
 def hold(n):
  for _ in range(n):s.step(s.hold_action())
 def move(pos,speed=.04,settle=0):
  a=s.tip_pose()[0];pos=np.array(pos);n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(pos-a)/speed*20)))
  for k in range(1,n+1):s.step(ik(a+(pos-a)*k/n))
  hold(settle)
 def point(u,v,z):return np.array([*s.geo.px_to_world(u,v),z])
 move([-.1,.15,.045],.1,10);move([-.1,.15,.025],.02,10);move([-.1,.15,.045],.02,5)
 m=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<128;px=s.geo.px_m*1000
 er=int(np.ceil(width/2/px+.5));safe=cv2.erode(m.astype('uint8'),np.ones((2*er+1,1),'uint8'))
 rows=np.arange(np.where(m)[0].min()+er,np.where(m)[0].max()-er,spacing/px)
 depth=(width+.3)/1.187;drag=1.38+1.075*depth
 segments=[]
 for i,v in enumerate(rows):
  row=safe[int(round(v))];starts=np.where(np.diff(np.r_[0,row,0].astype(int))==1)[0];ends=np.where(np.diff(np.r_[0,row,0].astype(int))==-1)[0]-1
  pair=list(zip(starts,ends))
  if i%2:pair=pair[::-1]
  for a,b in pair:
   a+=.8;b-=.8
   if (b-a)*px<drag+.8:continue
   direction=1 if i%2==0 else -1
   start=a+drag/px if direction==1 else b-drag/px;end=b if direction==1 else a
   segments.append((start,end,float(v),direction))
 print('plan',len(segments), 'width',width,'spacing',spacing,'depth',depth,'drag',drag,flush=True)
 for idx,(start,end,v,direction) in enumerate(segments):
  # Light contact has zero footprint width. Approach determines tuft direction.
  prime=start-direction*8/px
  if idx==0:move(point(prime,v,.03),.08,10);move(point(prime,v,.02-neutral/1000),.008,12)
  else:move(point(prime,v,.02-neutral/1000),.05,5)
  move(point(start,v,.02-neutral/1000),prime_speed,15)
  move(point(start,v,.02-depth/1000),.002,8)
  move(point(end,v,.02-depth/1000),speed,15)
  move(point(end,v,.02-neutral/1000),.002,8)
  if idx%50==0:
   print('progress',idx,'steps',s.n_steps,'contacts',len(s.strokes())+(s.painter.cur is not None),'theta',s.brush_state()['theta_rad'],'elapsed',time.time()-t0,flush=True)
   Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT+'/trial.png')
 move(s.tip_pose()[0]+[0,0,.025],.008,20)
 acts=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(acts,OUT+'/trajectory.npz');np.save(OUT+'/ink.npy',s.ink());Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT+'/trial.png')
 print('local',metrics(s.ink()),'contacts',len(s.strokes()),'steps',len(acts),'elapsed',time.time()-t0,flush=True)
 print('stats',s.painter.stats,flush=True)
 if score:
  sc=s.status();print('score',json.dumps(sc),flush=True);open(OUT+'/metrics.json','w').write(json.dumps(sc,indent=2))
 return s
if __name__=='__main__':
 a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('--width',type=float,default=.8);a.add_argument('--spacing',type=float,default=.3);a.add_argument('--neutral',type=float,default=.24);a.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=.025);a.add_argument('--prime-speed',type=float,default=.18);a.add_argument('--no-score',action='store_true');x=a.parse_args();run(x.width,x.spacing,x.neutral,x.speed,x.prime_speed,not x.no_score)
